question: By how many percentage points did the surface fluorine mass ratio fall through the Cyrene-based separation?
rendered: According to the document, the mass ratio of fluorine element on the surface of the cathode rejects was 12.49%, and that value was greatly reduced to 0.14% after the Cyrene-based separation process. Therefore, the surface fluorine mass ratio fell by 12.35 percentage points.
